The '''Perma families''' was a criminal organization located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core world]] of [[Perma]].

==History==
Prior to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] served as their Senior [[Medic/Legends|Medic]].
